title: 第一卷 第22章 云阳比武第一卷 第21章 两难抉择
slug: 百倍返还我家孽徒全是女帝转世
content_zh:
接下来的几日，魔修迟迟没有再出现，林枫不知道那个“幕后人”打的什么算盘，他也不在乎。
然而自那之后，柳雨姝的眉眼间就常带着几分沉郁，整个小竹峰的气氛变得压抑。
林枫看在眼里，索性放下修炼：“雨姝、赤瑶，收拾一番，随我下山。”
两女皆是一愣。
“师父，我们下山何事？”柳雨姝轻声问道。
“最近魔修暂时不敢来犯，也没有什么要事，便带你们下山散心，游历一番。”
赤瑶瞬间眼睛一亮，满脸雀跃：“多谢师父！”
这时一道洪亮的声音传来。
“老大，那我呢？”
只见王肖目光灼灼的看像林枫。
林枫有些心虚，自从把王肖收为手下之后就没怎么派上用场，所以也没有怎么管他。
原本是不打算带上他的，但是现在他又有了其他的想法。
“你也去。”
王肖激动的蹦了一下，他已经攒了很多灵石，就愁没有什么机会下山玩。
片刻功夫，几人就简单收拾妥当。
林枫一袭紫袍随风轻扬，赤瑶则载着王肖，几道身影御空而行，朝着云阳城飞去。
云阳城毗邻青云山脉，此地灵气较为稀薄，百姓安居乐业，属于皇家的地界。
师徒几人落地便换上了寻常凡人的装扮，混在人流当中慢悠悠的逛着。
街道两旁商铺林立，行人络绎不绝。
柳雨姝看着热闹的人间烟火，心头的阴郁散去大半。

她从前流浪的时候，看到这种繁华场面就会心头刺痛，不敢奢望这样的生活。
如今她却成了高高在上的修仙者，开始俯视这样的生活。
她默默握紧了拳头：这世间她唯一要追逐的便是力量，唯一值得的停下来保护只有师父和师妹。
她内心早已把他们当成了家人。
赤瑶则好奇打量着云阳城的新鲜事物。
行至城中心的街道，前方忽然围满了密密麻麻的人群。
锣鼓喧天，热闹非凡。
“快快快！武馆比武招亲要开始了！”
“听说武馆馆主的女儿貌美如花，今日擂台招亲，赢的人真是有福了！”
“不少城中俊杰都上去比试了，快去看！”
嘈杂的议论声传入耳中。
林枫抬眸望去，只见前方一个武馆内挤满了人，依稀可以看见里面有一座巨大的木质擂台，两侧挂着红绸。
前方的楼台上站着一名温婉女子，容貌姣好，应是武馆的千金。
赤瑶看得新奇，忍不住开口：“师父，凡人的比武招亲，倒是有趣。”
林枫瞥了眼身旁跃跃欲试的小徒弟，笑道：“你是想上去凑热闹？”
赤瑶点点头，随即脸颊微热：“弟子是女子，上去比武招亲，未免太奇怪了。”
“这个简单。”
林枫轻笑抬手，指尖一抬，一缕灵力飘过赤瑶周身。
流光一闪，赤瑶直接从明艳动人的少女，变成了一个身型高大，样貌普通的男人。
气质完美的融入周围的场景。

一旁的柳雨姝看得目瞪口呆，忍不住轻声道：“这模样，还真看不出来！”
赤瑶抬手摸了摸自己的眉眼，又看向擂台。
“师尊，那弟子便上去玩玩？”
content_en:
In the next few days, the demon cultivator did not appear again. Lin Feng didn't know what the "man behind the scenes" had planned, and he didn't care.
However, since then, Liu Yushu's eyebrows often looked a little gloomy, and the atmosphere in Xiaozhu Peak became depressing.
Lin Feng saw this and simply put down his practice: "Yushu, Chiyao, pack up and follow me down the mountain."
Both women were stunned.
"Master, why are we going down the mountain?" Liu Yushu asked softly.
"The demon cultivators have not dared to invade recently, and there is nothing important to do, so I will take you down the mountain to relax and travel around."
Chi Yao's eyes lit up instantly, and her face was full of joy: "Thank you, Master!"
At this time, a loud voice came.
"Boss, what about me?"
Wang Xiao looked like Lin Feng with stern eyes.
Lin Feng felt a little guilty. Since he took Wang Xiao as his subordinate, he had not been put to much use, so he did not care about him much.
Originally, he didn't plan to take him with him, but now he has other ideas.
"You go too."
Wang Xiao jumped excitedly. He had accumulated a lot of spiritual stones, but he was worried that he would not have much chance to go down the mountain to play.
In a short time, a few people simply packed up.
Lin Feng wore a purple robe that fluttered in the wind, while Chiyao carried Wang Xiao, and several figures flew through the air towards Yunyang City.
Yunyang City is adjacent to the Qingyun Mountains. The spiritual energy here is relatively thin, and the people live and work in peace and contentment. It belongs to the royal territory.
After landing, the master and apprentice put on ordinary mortal clothes and walked slowly among the crowd.
There are many shops on both sides of the street and there is an endless stream of pedestrians.
Liu Yushu looked at the lively fireworks in the world, and most of the gloom in her heart disappeared.
When she was wandering in the past, her heart would hurt when she saw this bustling scene, and she didn't dare to expect such a life.
Now she has become a high-ranking immortal cultivator and begins to look down on this kind of life.
She silently clenched her fists: the only thing she wanted to pursue in this world was power, and the only ones worth stopping to protect were her master and junior sister.
She already regarded them as family in her heart.
Chi Yao curiously looked at the new things in Yunyang City.
As we walked to the street in the center of the city, we were suddenly surrounded by a dense crowd.
The gongs and drums are noisy and lively.
"Hurry, hurry! The martial arts competition is about to begin!"
"I heard that the daughter of the master of the martial arts school is as beautiful as a flower. She is looking for a bride in the ring today. The winner will be really lucky!"
"Many of the city's heroes have gone up to compete, come and see!"
Noisy discussion reached his ears.
Lin Feng looked up and saw a martial arts hall in front of him packed with people. He could vaguely see a huge wooden arena inside with red silk hanging on both sides.
There was a gentle woman standing on the balcony in front of her. She had a beautiful appearance and should be the daughter of a martial arts school.
Chi Yao was so surprised by what he saw that he couldn't help but say: "Master, a mortal contest to recruit a bride is quite interesting."
Lin Feng glanced at the young apprentice beside him who was eager to try, and said with a smile: "Do you want to go up and join in the fun?"
Chi Yao nodded, and then his cheeks warmed slightly: "The disciple is a woman, it would be too strange to compete in martial arts to recruit a bride."
"This is simple."
Lin Feng chuckled and raised his hand, lifting his fingertips, a ray of spiritual power floated around Chi Yao.
In a flash of light, Chi Yao transformed from a bright and charming girl into a tall, ordinary-looking man.
The temperament blends perfectly into the surrounding scene.
Liu Yushu on the side was stunned and couldn't help but whispered: "You can't tell from this look!"
Chi Yao raised his hand and touched his eyebrows, then looked towards the ring.
"Master, will this disciple go up and have fun?"
